in_sanskrit.name: Sourabh
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings the light of dawn or the sunrise

in_tamil.name: சூரப்

in_telugu.name: శూరభ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The lord of dawn, the lord of the sunrise

in_marathi.name: Sourab
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Brave, Golden
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sourab हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sourab is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' which means Sun. The name Sourab is believed to represent the golden light of the sun and the inner strength and bravery it embodies.
